text: This report recommends the 2025 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council's approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Approved the following 2025 meeting dates: - Friday, February 7, 2025; - Friday, March 21, 2025; - Friday, May 2, 2025; - Friday, June 13, 2025; - Friday, September 5, 2025; - Friday, October 17, 2025; and - Friday, November 28, 2025.
